entry_text: Order placed, 14 items (dry goods, paper towels, dish soap, 6 cans San Marzano tomatoes). Scheduled delivery window: Apr 21 10:00–12:00.
Delivery completed to rear loading door, 24th St. 3 items substituted.

Customer: you swapped the San Marzanos for store-brand crushed tomato again. I run Brasa Cielo, I can't put that on the menu. Third time this month. Agent: I'm sorry about that. We've issued a credit for the substituted item.
Cart abandoned at checkout, 9 items. Session 1h 04m.

1:20 AM after close. Built the whole cart, saw the earliest delivery without Plus was Thursday, closed the app and wrote Restaurant Depot on the whiteboard instead. My daughters make fun of me because I'm on the Basketly billboard and I don't even have Plus anymore.
Substitution rejected: 2 of 6 items. Order partially refunded.
Delivery late: arrived 2h 40m after scheduled window.
Went back to the warehouse club for the restaurant stuff. The only reason I still open the app is my wife's shampoo.
Order placed: 2 items (dress socks, phone charger). Delivery instructions: leave with the front desk at the Salesforce Tower, 415 Mission St lobby, attn 42nd floor.
Delivered to front desk. Signed by: lobby security.
Gift order placed: engraved silver bracelet + card. Ship to: Chloe M., Apt 5C, 1100 Gough St. Gift message: 'Two years this week. Wish it were more than Tuesdays. — D'
Gift order placed: flower arrangement + chocolate box. Ship to: home address, Noe Valley. Gift message: 'Happy 12th. Love you.'
Put both anniversary orders through on my phone at the office so neither one shows up on the family iPad. The front desk guys at the tower know me by name now.
Gift delivery to Gough St confirmed. Photo on doorstep.
Cart completed at checkout, 3 items. Session 4m.

Customer: can you make sure gift orders don't show up under 'Buy again' on the other devices on my account? Agent: Order history is visible on every device signed into the account, but you can archive individual orders.
Recurring order fulfilled: Jameson Irish whiskey (1.75 L x2), 12 frozen Salisbury steak dinners, canned split-pea soup, 2 boxes Hostess cupcakes.
Delivered. Driver note: handed to home aide at side door, Portola house.

Dad asked the aide when the whiskey was coming again this morning. The recurring order is the one thing in this house that just shows up. I can't be the one in the Safeway on San Bruno with a cart full of liquor and frozen dinners, not with campaign staff photographing everything I do.
Recurring order adjusted: frozen dinners increased to 18 per week.

Customer: the whiskey came in a clear bag with the label facing out, and the aide said the neighbor was right there on the stoop. Can these come in plain boxes? Agent: I've added a discreet-packaging note to your recurring order.
Cart completed at checkout, 5 items. Session 3m.
Delivery completed on time.
Budget hearing ran until 9. The order was already on the porch when I got home. That's why I keep paying for Plus.
Order placed: 20 medium moving boxes, packing tape, bubble wrap. Ship to NEW address: Unit 3, 88 Crestline Ave, Pacifica. Saved as 'Mom's place.'
Delivery failed: address not found in routing. Returned to hub.

Customer: please don't send anything else to the Daly City house. Everything should go to the Pacifica address and I don't want the old one as my default anymore. Agent: I've updated your default address. Address changes appear in the account activity log, which all household members can see.

First order to the new place, he doesn't know the address. He's at the Marketline standups Thursday and I don't want him seeing a shipping notification pop up on the family iPad. The kids think we're 'staying at Grandma's for a while.'
Order placed: twin bed frame x2, kids' sheet sets, plug-in nightlight.
Delivery late: arrived next day. Oversized-item fee applied (non-Plus).
Cart abandoned at checkout, 6 items. Delivery fee displayed: $9.99.
Returned: 1 twin bed frame. Reason given: 'Only need one, the little one is sleeping with me.'
Order placed: 50 lb soy wax flakes (seller: Golden Hive Supply), 200 pre-tabbed cotton wicks.
Delivery completed. 1 of 2 boxes damaged in transit.

Customer: This is Fog & Ember Candle Co. Golden Hive Supply shipped me 30 lb of wax labeled as 50 for the second time, and their owner told me to 'take it up with Basketly' and then blocked my storefront messages. I want to file a claim. Agent: I've opened seller dispute #SD-44817 against Golden Hive Supply.

A one-star just showed up on my shop from a brand-new account, the same week I filed. I'm sure it's Golden Hive. My partner says let it go. I'm not letting it go, that was three weeks of Mother's Day inventory.
Returned: 30 lb soy wax (short-weight). Reason: 'Item not as described — weight mismatch.'
Substitution accepted: coconut-soy blend in place of soy wax (out of stock).
Cart completed at checkout, 4 items. Session 5m.
Customer: any update on SD-44817? Agent: The seller has 48 hours to respond. Your Plus membership includes priority dispute handling.
Order placed: 20-vol developer, foil roll, 3 boxes nitrile gloves. Delivery instructions: back door of my salon on Valencia, Petal & Shear near 19th, ring twice, do not leave on the sidewalk.
Delivered to rear entrance, Petal & Shear, Valencia St. Photo confirmation.
Order placed: personal items (sleep shirt, 2 paperbacks, vitamin D). Delivery: same salon back door.

Every package I get goes to the salon now. Three got taken off the stoop at my building on Guerrero last month. Clients see the Basketly bags piled next to the shampoo sink and ask what I bought, which, whatever.
Cart completed at checkout, 3 items. Session 6m.
Delivery completed on time.
Returned: blonde toner. Reason: 'Wrong shade shipped.'
Customer: can I make the salon my default address without the salon name printed on the label? Agent: The label shows whatever business name is saved on the address. You can edit it under Addresses.
Order placed: 48 juice boxes, 3 boxes clementines, 12-pack training cones. Deliver to: Polo Field parking lot B, Saturday 8:30 AM, 'Coach — U10 Sunset Surf.'
Order placed: home pregnancy test (2-pack). Separate checkout from team order.
Two lines. I didn't tell Jake. I carried the box out to the street bin at 11 PM so it wouldn't be sitting in our recycling on Thursday. Half the parents on the team live on my block.
Order placed: prenatal vitamins (90 ct), ginger chews.

Customer: can the vitamins come in plain packaging? My boyfriend opens everything that comes to the apartment. Agent: Plain packaging isn't available for this item, but you can choose locker pickup at Irving St.
Delivered to Basketly Locker, Irving St & 22nd Ave. Picked up 14 min after delivery.
Browsed: Baby Registry (12 min). No items added.
Not telling him yet. Not until after the season. I'll figure out how to coach Saturdays without the parents noticing I'm sitting down a lot.
Cart built, 11 items (school snacks, laundry pods, kids' sneakers, comforter). Cart abandoned at checkout.
Order placed: laundry pods, school snacks. Delivery instructions: gate code #4471, Building C unit 212, don't knock, kids asleep.
Delivery failed: gate code invalid. Driver unable to access complex.
Customer: the code changed on the 1st, it's 4471 now, I updated it. This is the second failed one. Agent: I've rescheduled your delivery. Without Plus, the next available window is Thursday.
Card declined at checkout. Cart saved.

Filled the cart at 1 AM after my last ride. Kids' sneakers, a new comforter for the little one, stuff we don't need yet. Sat in the parking lot looking at it and deleted half. The card didn't go through anyway. I cancelled Plus in March because $14.99 is a tank of gas.
Returned: kids' sneakers (size 2). Reason: 'Ordered late at night, didn't need them yet.'
Delivery completed. Left at Building C mailroom.
Order placed: coffee beans, protein bars, blackout curtains. Delivery instructions: garden-level in-law unit, side gate, do NOT ring bell 9 AM–4 PM, night shift.
Delivery attempted 11:14 AM. Doorbell rung. Delivery failed: recipient unavailable (signature required).

The driver rang the bell at 11 AM, two hours after I got to sleep off a 12-hour shift in the unit. Couldn't get to the door in time. That's the third missed one. Cancelled Plus on April 2. I'm not paying for delivery windows I'm asleep through.
Customer: can you just waive the signature? I'm a nurse, I sleep during the day. Agent: Signature-waived delivery isn't available for this item category.
Delivery failed: recipient unavailable. Returned to hub.
Cart abandoned at checkout, 3 items. Earliest window shown: Apr 27 10:00–14:00.
Returned: blackout curtains. Reason: 'Missed delivery twice, bought them at Target on the way home.'
Ordered off the break-room tablet during the 3 AM lull. Frozen dinners for one, same as every week since the divorce.
Order placed: shower curtain, 2 bath towels, frying pan, queen bedding set. Delivery: Unit 14, Crocker Townhomes, gate code 2290#, intercom broken, call cell.
Delivery failed: unable to access gated entrance.
Customer: the gate code is in the notes. The intercom's been broken since I moved in in March. Agent: Our driver reported that the code was not accepted. Please confirm the code.
Substitution rejected: queen bedding set replaced with twin. Refund issued.
Still buying everything for this place one piece at a time. She kept the house and the pans. The kids come Saturday and I want the second room to look like an actual room.
Delivery completed on 2nd attempt. Left at gate.
Cart abandoned at checkout, 7 items. Session 22m.
Returned: 2 bath towels. Reason: 'Wrong color, not what the picture showed.'
Order placed 1:47 AM: noise-cancelling headphones, standing desk converter, 2 dress shirts.
Stress ordering again. Interview prep at midnight and suddenly I need a standing desk. My wife keeps the returns spreadsheet now because I stopped opening it.
Returned: standing desk converter. Reason: 'Changed my mind.'
Returned: 2 dress shirts. Reason: 'Bought for an interview that got cancelled.'
Order placed 2:10 AM: mechanical keyboard, desk lamp.
Cart completed at checkout, 2 items. Session 3m.
Returned: mechanical keyboard (opened). Reason: 'Don't need it, still looking for work.'
Delivery completed on time.
Shared household order (3 members): paper towels, oat milk, dish soap, trash bags.
Order placed on personal account: yeast infection treatment, period underwear (3-pack), 12-pack energy drinks. Delivery: shared house off Shattuck, room 2.
Put the personal stuff on my own account so it doesn't show up on the roommates' shared list. Defense is in three weeks and I don't need Maya asking me about it in the kitchen.
Delivery failed: recipient unavailable. Package handed to housemate.
Customer: the driver handed my order to my roommate. It was supposed to be left at my door. Agent: Deliveries to shared addresses may be handed to any resident at the address.
Cart abandoned at checkout, 5 items. Free-delivery minimum not met (free tier).
Downgraded on the 18th because the stipend doesn't stretch. Now every order is a delivery-fee calculation. Mostly I just walk to Berkeley Bowl.
